'''Vasanti N. Bhat-Nayak''' (10 June 1938 – 12 February 2009) was a [[mathematician]] whose research concerned [[balanced incomplete block design]]s, [[bivariegated graph]]s, [[graceful graph]]s, [[graph equations]] and [[frequency partition]]s.
She earned a [[Ph.D.]] from the [[University of Mumbai]] in 1970 with the dissertation ''Some New Results in PBIBD Designs and Combinatorics''. [[S. S. Shrikhande]] was her advisor.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=84166}}</ref>


After completing her doctorate, she remained on the faculty at the university, and eventually served as department head.<ref>{{citation|url=https://thewire.in/science/ss-shrikhande-math-latin-square-euler|title=Celebrating Sharadchandra Shrikhande, the Mathematician Who Disproved Euler|magazine=The Wire|first=Nithyanand|last=Rao|date=12 November 2017}}</ref> She had 44 publications in the field of [[Combinatorics]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=American Mathematical Society |url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/author?authorId=36390 |access-date=Feb 16, 2024}}</ref>
